paths.name: Maastricht MSc Global Health + NL High Potential Scholarship
paths.cost: €1,550/month; €100 UM handling fee (not covered by UM)
paths.dt: Complete programme file before 10 Dec 2026; scholarship closes 1 Feb 2027, 23:59 CET
paths.note: Gates: GPA at least 7.5/10 (75%); age 35 or under on 1 Sep 2027; about 2% of applicants awarded. Open question: whether UM puts an MBBS on the bachelor's route (GRE General needed) or the bachelor's + master's route (no GRE). Ask UM admissions.

paths.name: Maastricht MSc Epidemiology + NL High Potential Scholarship
paths.cost: €1,550/month; €100 UM handling fee (not covered by UM)
paths.dt: Complete programme file before 10 Dec 2026; scholarship closes 1 Feb 2027
paths.note: Same deadlines, GPA and GRE gates as the Global Health MSc. Caution: the MSc is listed part-time while the scholarship is for full-time programmes; confirm on UM's 2027-28 participating-programmes list that the full-time variant is eligible.

paths.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28
paths.cost: Free (tuition + stipend, jointly funded)
paths.dt: Opens 10 Nov 2026 · closes 8 Dec 2026, 16:00 GMT
paths.note: Apply to an approved course at the university AND through the CSC portal. Bangladesh eligible. Needs, by September 2027, a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) or equivalent — how an MBBS maps to 2:1, and whether the degree is conferred before the internship ends, are open questions. The 2027 approved-course list is published before opening.

paths.name: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg PhD in Epidemiology
paths.cost: $155 SOPHAS fee ($65 each extra) + $52,000/year stipend, tuition, fees, medical
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 via SOPHAS (supporting documents within 2 weeks after)
paths.note: Strongest verified fully funded US fit. A prior graduate degree is 'not required, but highly recommended'. WES ICAP ($239) or ECE credential evaluation required; ECFMG not accepted. GRE not required or reviewed. Three letters; statement of objectives limited to two pages (Epi FAQ). English: IELTS 7, Duolingo 130, PTE 68, TOEFL iBT 100 for older scores or 5.0 on the new scale. Open question: the programme page lists one year of full-time work experience, but the Epi FAQ says it is only strongly recommended; email BSPH.EpiAcademic@jh.edu to confirm whether internship counts. Stipend rates beyond June 2027 depend on union negotiations.

paths.name: Emory Rollins PhD in Epidemiology
paths.cost: $75 Laney fee + full tuition + $43,260/year (FY26–27 union rate)
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 — final deadline for PhD applicants (midnight US Eastern)
paths.note: Applies through the Laney Graduate School ($75), not SOPHAS. Full-tuition scholarship for all admitted PhD students plus stipend. A bachelor's is the stated minimum, so MBBS meets it; GRE optional. Three letters, 500-word statement of purpose plus a 500-word collaborative-communities statement, and name at least two Epidemiology faculty. Credential evaluation is not mandatory for Laney, but the Rollins general page says WES: ask. No numeric English minimum found. Very competitive: 200+ applications for 10–14 places, and admitted students often hold advanced degrees.

paths.name: UNC Gillings PhD in Epidemiology
paths.cost: Funding possible, not guaranteed
paths.note: Master's 'beneficial but not required'. Funding is assembled competitively (RA/TA, Graduate School awards). Departmental NIH T32-type training grants usually require US citizenship or permanent residence, so that leg is closed to him. Tuition remission is possible but not guaranteed.

paths.name: Emory Rollins MPH (merit scholarship)
paths.cost: Merit awards 50-100% of tuition; no stipend; REAL up to $3,000/semester (apply after admission); COA $85,356

paths.note: Internationals are considered automatically if verified by 5 Jan; merit 50-100% of tuition. REAL pays up to $3,000 per semester (fall and spring), apply after admission if work-eligible. 2026-27 cost of attendance $85,356 including tuition $43,264. No stipend, so it fails the full-funding filter alone; viable only with paid work alongside (the Sakib model). 'Rollins Pathways' scholarship not found on the official page.

paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 (work rule waived for non-US MBBS)

paths.name: The Sakib model: MPH + US research jobs
paths.cost: MPH with up to ~$50k scholarship, living costs from campus jobs
paths.dt: No scheme deadline; each programme sets its own (e.g. Brown, Columbia 1 Dec 2026; Emory 5 Jan; GSU 15 Feb 2027)
paths.note: A working route, not a scholarship (personal account by Dr. Iftekhar Ahmed Sakib, not an official source). Applied via SOPHAS to MPH programmes, won scholarship money with no stipend, and covers the rest with US jobs. SOPHAS fee waiver ($155, first programme only) is open to citizens who live in a UN Least Developed Country such as Bangladesh: request it before submitting, then submit within 14 days; an $80 WES coupon is on the same form. F-1: on-campus work 20 hours a week in term (assistantships count), CPT after one full academic year, OPT 12 months. Applying while MBBS or internship is in progress is normal: offers are contingent on completion before enrolment.
paths.change: Updated 9 Nov 2026: waiver and F-1 rules checked on official pages.

paths.name: DAAD Study Scholarship (Master's)
paths.cost: €992/month + insurance + €460 study allowance + travel allowance; DAAD does not pay tuition
paths.dt: Bangladesh window 1 Jun - 31 Aug 2026 closed (funding from Oct 2027); next call not yet published
paths.note: Germany's realistic funded route for him: no professional-experience requirement is listed (EPOS needs 2+ years). Needs a first degree finished by the start of funding (no more than about 6 years old at the deadline) and admission to a full-time master's at a state-recognised German university.

paths.name: Italy DSU regional scholarship
paths.cost: ≈€7,171+/year grant + full tuition exemption + meals, often housing
paths.dt: 2027/28 regional calls expected around July 2027 (not yet published)
paths.note: Italy's main route. Money comes from the region, based on family income, not grades: family ISEE ≤ €28,339.88 and ISPE ≤ €61,608.48 (2026/27 ceilings). As a Bangladeshi, family income and asset papers are legalised, translated and turned into an 'ISEE parificato' by a CAF office — start collecting them now. Get admitted to an English-taught public-health or epidemiology master's first.

paths.name: MRC North West Doctoral Programme in Medical Sciences (Manchester + Liverpool)
paths.cost: Fully funded: tuition (home or international rate) + UKRI-rate stipend for 4 years; application fee not found
paths.dt: Fri 27 Nov 2026 (no closing time stated). Interviews w/c 8 Feb 2027, awards w/c 22 Feb 2027.
paths.note: Project-led PhD: you apply to a named advertised project (up to two, each a separate application with its own tailored supporting statement) and contacting the supervisor first is called one of the most important steps. International applicants are eligible. Funding is tuition at the home or international rate plus a stipend at the UKRI rate for four years; the UKRI minimum is 21,805 GBP a year from 1 Oct 2026, but the Manchester page prints no figure and the 2027/28 rate may differ. Expected degree is a First or Upper Second (or international equivalent); whether an MBBS counts is not stated, so email fbmh.doctoralacademy.admissions@manchester.ac.uk. You need a supporting statement (no word limit, 2 to 4 pages recommended), a CV, transcripts, and two referees with institutional email addresses; no research statement and no English test at application. Interviews are on Teams for supervisor-nominated applicants only. Application fee: not confirmed on the official page.
paths.change: Added 9 Nov 2026 from the uploaded notes, checked on official pages.

paths.name: Yale PhD in Public Health (GSAS)
paths.cost: $105 fee (waiver possible); 5-year guarantee: tuition ($52,400 in 2026-27) + 12-month stipend + health coverage
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026, 11:59 pm Eastern, via the Yale GSAS application (not SOPHAS)
paths.note: Apply through the Yale GSAS PhD/Master's application, not SOPHAS. All YSPH PhD students are guaranteed five years of tuition and 12-month stipend support; the GSAS minimum stipend for 2026-27 is $52,046 or $53,629 depending on the band, and the band for Public Health is not stated. No master's is required, but whether a Bangladeshi MBBS counts as the equivalent is not ruled on, so email phdms.publichealth@yale.edu. You need 3 letters, a CV and a statement of research interests naming up to 3 faculty; unofficial transcripts are enough, no writing sample, no mentor needed in advance. GRE is not accepted for the two epidemiology concentrations. English: only TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic, with minimum Speaking scores for the PhD (admitted average TOEFL 106, IELTS 7.5); a waiver exists for an English-medium undergraduate degree with at least 3 years in residence. Five-year acceptance rate is 3%.
paths.change: Added 9 Nov 2026 from the uploaded notes, checked on official pages.

paths.name: University of Pittsburgh IBGP PhD (biomedical science)
paths.cost: $50 fee; $41,200 stipend (2026-27) + full tuition remission + insurance + $2,000 first-year enrichment
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 (no time of day stated); rolling review, early complete files help
paths.note: The Interdisciplinary Biomedical Graduate Program is lab-based biomedical science, not public health. Funding is a $41,200 stipend for 2026-27, full tuition remission, individual health insurance and a $2,000 first-year enrichment award. Degree should be in a biological or physical science, mathematics, computer science or engineering, with a minimum GPA of 3.2 of 4 or equivalent (incoming average 3.7); whether an MBBS fits is for the program to judge. All successful applicants have research experience, most with 1+ year in a lab. You need 3 letters (the research-advisor letter is very important) and a personal statement whose research description is heavily weighed; GRE is not required. English: TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5 on the new scale), IELTS 7.0 or Duolingo 120, under 24 months old, unless exempt through a degree from an approved English-instructed institution. Interviews Jan to Mar, overseas by teleconference; offers by 15 April.
paths.change: Added 9 Nov 2026 from the uploaded notes, checked on official pages.

paths.name: Johns Hopkins PhD in Global Disease Epidemiology and Control (International Health)
paths.cost: $155 SOPHAS fee; $52,000/year minimum stipend through June 2027 + tuition, fees, medical benefits
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 via SOPHAS for an August 2027 start; GRE REQUIRED
paths.note: A degree in medicine explicitly qualifies for this program; work experience is 'not required but highly desirable'. The big practical catch is that the GRE is required (unlike Hopkins Epidemiology), with about 3 weeks left. The GRE waiver applies only to people who submitted official GRE scores for the Hopkins MSPH in International Health and were admitted within 10 years; requests were due 1 Nov, so it does not help you. Funding: PhD students are guaranteed a minimum $52,000 stipend through June 2027 (later amounts depend on the union agreement) plus tuition, fees and medical benefits, guaranteed for at least the first four years. It is a STEM-designated program (24-month STEM OPT extension for eligible F-1 students). General Bloomberg School rules apply: three letters, WES ICAP or ECE credential evaluation (ECFMG not accepted) and English scores or a WES/ECE-based waiver. Found by Claude while checking Hopkins pages; not in your uploaded notes.
paths.change: Added 9 Nov 2026: found while checking Hopkins pages; not in the uploaded notes; checked on the official programme page.

paths.name: Groningen Eric Bleumink Fellowship (Master's, nomination-only)
paths.cost: EUR 100 Master's application fee; fellowship pays tuition + EUR 1,250/month + EUR 275 settling + EUR 310/year study allowance + flights + insurance
paths.dt: Complete the Groningen Master's application before 1 Dec 2026; nominees chosen first week of Jan 2027
paths.note: You cannot apply for this fellowship: Groningen's Admissions Office nominates candidates in the first week of January, so the only action is a complete Master's application before 1 Dec 2026. Only four grants are awarded a year against hundreds of applications. Each pays tuition, EUR 1,250 a month, a EUR 275 settling allowance, EUR 310 a year for books, return flights and insurance, but fellows may not take paid work in the Netherlands, there is no provision for family, and they state they will return to their own country afterwards. Bangladesh is on the country list (the tier is read from a garbled table, so likely first preference rather than certain). The best-fit programme is the MSc Interdisciplinary Research in Health Dynamics (non-EU tuition EUR 24,900 for 2027-28), where it is not confirmed that a foreign MBBS is a named qualifying degree; ask irhd@umcg.nl. Questions on the grant go to msd@rug.nl.

paths.name: Doha Institute Tamim Scholarship (Master's)
paths.cost: 100% tuition waiver, student housing, monthly stipend (amount not published), health insurance
paths.dt: Admission application closes 15 Jan 2027 (opened 1 Sep 2026); scholarship invitation comes after admission
paths.note: Full package for international master's students: 100% tuition waiver, student housing, a monthly stipend and health insurance. The stipend amount is not published on the official page. You apply for admission first; admitted students are then contacted and invited to apply for the scholarship. Programmes are policy and social science (Public Administration, Public Policy, Development Economics and others); no clinical or public-health master's was seen, and executive masters are excluded. The 10 hours a week work rule belongs to the doctoral scholarship, not this master's one. You cannot combine it with another scholarship, and continuing depends on academic standing.

paths.note: Genuinely full funding at McGill: tuition and fees for the whole master's, a living stipend of CAD 2,300 a month in academic terms, a one-time relocation grant and up to CAD 5,000 for summer initiatives. International places: 10 scholarships, 25 Finalist Awards of CAD 20,000 a year for up to 2 years, and 15 Regional Awards of CAD 10,000. Applications for Summer/Fall 2027 are closed (international deadline 19 Aug 2026). Next cycle (Summer/Fall 2028) dates are not yet published; the FAQ says the deadline falls 12-15 months before the programme starts, which points to around Aug 2027 (pattern only, unconfirmed). You would need a first bachelor's in the last five years, or be 30 or under, and meet McGill's own degree and language rules. PhDs, executive masters and part-time study are excluded.

paths.name: Deakin University RTP Scholarship (PhD / Master's by research)
paths.cost: AUD 37,450 a year tax-free stipend, tuition fees offset, relocation AUD 500-1,500, OSHC for international students
paths.time: PhD (3 years stipend) or research master's (2 years), Feb 2027 intake
paths.dt: CLOSED. International round for Feb 2027 closed 23 Aug 2026; the 25 Oct 2026 date was the domestic round; next round not published
paths.note: Funded research degree at Deakin: stipend of AUD 37,450 a year tax exempt, tuition fees offset, a relocation allowance of AUD 500 to 1,500 and, for international candidates, single Overseas Student Health Cover for the visa period. A doctorate gets three years of stipend and four years of fee offset; a research master's gets two and two. The 2027 international round closed on 23 Aug 2026; the 25 Oct 2026 date in the notes belongs to the domestic round, and that is closed too. Eligibility includes at least four years of tertiary study and 80% or equivalent in the research component, on-campus full-time study, and only top-ranked applicants are offered an RTP. Next-round dates are not yet published, and the Institute for Frontier Materials, IISRI and A2I2 take applications at any time (per the how-to-apply page).

paths.cost: Tuition cut to EUR 2,771 for 2027/28 (amount to be confirmed), plus EUR 5,000 NL Scholarship; living costs not covered
paths.dt: Submit in OSIRIS by 31 Jan 2027 23:59 CET; application complete by 14 Feb 2027 23:59 CET; decision before mid-April 2027
paths.note: Partial scholarship, not a stipend. The Radboud Scholarship reduces tuition to EUR 2,771 (amount to be confirmed) and covers visa, residence permit, health insurance and liability insurance, but not living costs. The NL Scholarship adds EUR 5,000 for one year; you can hold both or just the RSP, never the NLS alone. There are at most 22 RSP and 22 NLS awards for 2027-28. Open to all non-EU/EEA nationals (Bangladesh qualifies), with a bachelor's from outside the Netherlands and full admission. Two reference letters and a CV go through OSIRIS; Erasmus Mundus and joint-degree masters are excluded. Two-year programmes need all first-year courses passed.

paths.note: KFUPM offers full scholarships to full-time MS and PhD students: no tuition, a stipend according to category, free furnished on-campus housing, air tickets for international students, medical and dental care, subsidised meals and free textbooks. Thesis-based MS needs a four-year bachelor's in engineering or science with a major in the proposed field or a suitable background, IELTS 6.0 (PhD 6.5) and two recommendation letters. An MBBS is unlikely to meet this. The 10 Feb 2027 date is for project-based MS, which is fee-paying; the thesis and PhD deadline was not found.

paths.cost: Assistantships exist (waiver and stipend amounts not confirmed); out-of-state tuition from $69,982 for the whole degree; supplemental fee $80
paths.dt: Priority 1 Dec 2026 for school-level aid; international deadline 1 Feb 2027 (CHS onsite)
paths.note: All fall master's programmes have a priority date of 1 Dec 2026 for guaranteed consideration for financial aid; the Community Health Sciences onsite international deadline is 1 Feb 2027. A supplemental application fee is $80 on the current MPH/MS apply page (older pages still say $70), plus SOPHAS. Out-of-state tuition starts at $69,982 for the degree ($43,161 in-state); an out-of-state tuition premium waiver programme exists. The notes' claim that appointments of 25-67% waive tuition was not confirmed.

paths.note: Priority deadline 15 Jan 2027 for first consideration for scholarship funding; 1 Mar 2027 for second consideration; applications are accepted space-available after that. paths.name: Dartmouth PhD in Quantitative Biomedical Sciences (Guarini School)
paths.cost: Free: full tuition + health insurance + $49,862.40/yr stipend (2026–27), 5 years guaranteed; $150 fee
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 (QBS PhD). The Dartmouth Institute's Health Policy & Clinical Practice PhD has its own date, which was not found
paths.note: Guarini funds every PhD student the same way: tuition, health insurance, stipend ($49,862.40 in 2026–27) and a relocation bonus, with funding guaranteed for five years in good standing (Guarini funding page, 13 Nov). The QBS page welcomes degrees in epidemiology, medical sciences and public health, but does not say whether an MBBS counts as the bachelor's, so ask. It says prior research experience is particularly important for international applicants. GRE optional; English test needed unless your degree was taught in English. Masters-level funding is NOT general: only a few Dartmouth master's degrees are funded.

paths.name: Chang Gung University Master's in biomedical and clinical sciences (Taiwan)
paths.cost: Free: tuition waiver + NTD 6,000/month stipend + free on-campus housing (quota-limited)
paths.dt: Round 1 closes 17 Nov 2026 (Taiwan time); Round 2 runs 29 Dec 2026 – 20 Feb 2027
paths.note: The Master's scholarship (CGU page, 13 Nov) is a monthly stipend of NTD 6,000 or a part-time research assistantship, a tuition and misc-fee waiver, and free on-campus housing in a quad room, with up to NTD 12,000/month extra possible. English bar: IELTS 5.0 or TOEFL iBT 61. Earlier research reported a quota of about 10 new international Master's students, an 80% average to keep the award, and that the doctoral scholarship does not waive tuition; those three points were not re-confirmed. Research fit is biomedical and clinical sciences; no public health programme was found. A Sept 2027 start clashes with the internship, so Round 2 and an enrolment-deferral question matter.

paths.name: MCW Global Young Leaders Fellowship 2027 (USA)
paths.cost: Free trip: flights, housing, meals; US$100 refundable deposit; no stipend, no fee
paths.dt: 3 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM New York time (10:59 AM Fri 4 Dec in Dhaka); second round closes 8 Jan 2027
paths.note: A short fellowship, not a degree. Ages 18–26 on 1 June 2027 with no exceptions stated, all nationalities, no degree requirement, fluent English. Covered: international economy flights, housing 19–29 Jul, three meals a day 20–29 Jul, New York–Burlington travel, airport public transport. Not covered: passport, visa and travel-to-airport costs. Two essays, a one-page resume, two recommendation letters (not friends or family) and a liability waiver; MCW warns that AI-written answers hurt selection. Check his date of birth against the 1 June 2027 age line before relying on this.

paths.name: ISRV School of Respiratory Viruses, Accra (10–14 May 2027)
paths.cost: Support is discretionary: a free place and travel help can be requested, none guaranteed
paths.dt: Expression of interest and scholarship application close 23:59 GMT on Mon 30 Nov 2026
paths.note: ISRV says funding is limited and not guaranteed, is considered case by case, and may differ from what you request; travel support does not automatically waive the registration fee. Earlier research found clinicians and epidemiologists/public-health professionals explicitly welcomed, and an LMIC residential rate of about £150; neither was re-confirmed on 13 Nov. This is training and networking, not a funded degree.
